llc.formation_notes: SOS schedule lists an additional 'Enhanced Fee' of $6.00 for online filing of Form 400. Professional LLC (Form 412) also $150.

annual_report.name: LLC Annual Report (Form 632)
annual_report.due: between February 1 and May 1 of each year after the year of formation
annual_report.late_penalty: $75 when filed with penalty imposed (schedule: 'Annual Report - Penalty Imposed $75')

state_tax_on_llc.name: Annual fee equal to the minimum tax (R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-2(e))
state_tax_on_llc.applies: every LLC filing Form RI-1065 (partnership or single-member LLC) and LLCs taxed as S corps (RI-1120S); a sole proprietor using RI-1065 only for the PTE election is exempt
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Paid on Form RI-1065 line 7a; single-member LLC return due the 15th day of the 4th month (April 15 for calendar year).

sources.quote: Enter the amount of $400.00 on this line. Pursuant to R.I. Gen. Laws § 44-11-2(e), the minimum tax imposed shall be $400.00.

entity_level_taxes.name: Business corporation minimum tax
entity_level_taxes.notes: S corps not subject to the 7% corporate income tax but pay the $400 minimum tax (since 2015); tax on built-in gains/passive income to the extent taxed federally.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: 5.99% entity-level election (R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-2.3), open to S corps, partnerships, LLCs and even sole proprietors; for tax years from 2025 owners get a credit of only 90% of the PTE tax paid. From 2027 the PTE may also elect to pay the new high-income surtax at entity level.

sources.title: R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-2 (read via web.archive.org copy dated 2026-07-15)
sources.quote: For tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2017, the tax imposed shall not be less than four hundred dollars ($400).

sources.title: R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-2.3 (read via web.archive.org copy dated 2026-09-02)
sources.quote: a pass-through entity may elect to pay the state tax at the entity level at the rate of five and ninety-nine hundredths percent (5.99%).

sources.title: RI Division of Taxation - Summary of Legislative Changes, July 22, 2026 (via web.archive.org)
sources.quote: may additionally elect to pay the High-Income Surtax at the entity level

personal_exemption.notes: $5,250 per personal/dependency exemption for 2026. Standard deduction and exemptions phase out for modified federal AGI between $261,000 and $290,800 (2026). Single uniform rate schedule for all filing statuses. Head of household standard deduction $16,800.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: New high-income surtax (FY2027 budget, H 7127 Sub A): 1% on income over $1 million (indexed) for tax year 2027, 2% for 2028, 3% from 2029. No surtax for tax year 2026.

sources.title: ADV 2025-22: Inflation-adjusted amounts set for Tax Year 2026 (via web.archive.org copy of 2025-11-05)
Summary of Legislative Changes, July 22, 2026
sources.quote: imposes a surtax of 1% on personal income over $1 million for the tax year beginning January 1, 2027.

estimated_tax.required_if: estimated RI income tax of $250 or more in excess of credits

unemployment_2026.notes: $32,300 wage base for employers at the highest rate. New employer rate 1.21% includes the 0.21% Job Development Assessment. Schedule F (0.9% to 9.4%). Separately, TDI (employee-paid) 1.1% on wages up to $100,000.

notable: Every LLC (including single-member) owes a $400 annual fee on Form RI-1065 on top of the $50 SOS annual report (https://tax.ri.gov/sites/g/files/xkgbur541/files/2026-01/2025%20RI-1065%20Instructions.pdf)
PTE election open to sole proprietors as well as LLCs/S corps, at 5.99%, but owners get only a 90% credit since 2025 (https://webserver.rilegislature.gov/Statutes/TITLE44/44-11/44-11-2.3.htm)
Millionaire surtax enacted in 2026: 1% (2027), 2% (2028), 3% (2029+) on income over $1M (https://tax.ri.gov/sites/g/files/xkgbur541/files/2026-07/2026_summary_of_legislative_changes.pdf)
Single bracket schedule for all filing statuses: married couples get no wider brackets (https://tax.ri.gov/sites/g/files/xkgbur541/files/2025-11/ADV_2025_22_Inflation_Adjustments.pdf)
Estimated tax required from only $250 of expected tax (https://tax.ri.gov/sites/g/files/xkgbur541/files/2026-01/2026%20RI-1040ES_w.pdf)
Tax amnesty Dec 3, 2026 to Feb 15, 2027 for periods ending on or before Dec 31, 2025 (summary of legislative changes)
